title: Registries in grafana-data are empty until app.ts calls setInit
answers: Why is standardTransformersRegistry empty in a test/script?
Where do package-level registries get populated?
Why does calling registry.list() before bootstrap return nothing?
body:
standardTransformersRegistry (packages/grafana-data/src/transformations/standardTransformersRegistry.ts) is created as a bare `new Registry<TransformerRegistryItem>()` with no items — it stays empty until public/app/app.ts:272 calls `standardTransformersRegistry.setInit(getStandardTransformers)` during app bootstrap, where getStandardTransformers (public/app/features/transformers/standardTransformers.tsx) attaches the React editor UI + icons per transformer.
Registry.setInit (packages/grafana-data/src/utils/Registry.ts:setInit, line 47) throws if called a second time; getIfExists()/list() lazily trigger initialize() on first use. Same pattern applies to other package-level registries populated externally by the app (e.g. field-config editor registries).
Any unit test that touches transformers/registries directly (outside full app bootstrap) must call `registry.setInit(...)` itself first — this pattern appears in 10+ test files across public/app (e.g. public/app/plugins/datasource/dashboard/datasource.test.ts, public/app/features/explore/utils/decorators.test.ts, TransformationOperationRows.test.tsx).
applies: Applies to any Registry instance defined in grafana-data and populated by public/app at bootstrap (transformers, field-config editors). Does not apply to registries that are self-contained and populated within the same package.
